title: phased-probe-suite-for-batching-cache-with-interleaved-human-validation
creator: Aisha Patel
description:
Goal: Build a phased probe suite that safely evaluates batching and KV-cache configuration recommendations by measuring semantic and behavioral regressions, combining automated signal scoring with targeted human validation. The suite will run shadow/sidecar experiments and a staged apply flow (dry-run -> low-traffic canary -> progressive ramp) and provide deterministic rollback triggers.

Context: We are automating batch/cache recommendations to reduce token cost. Previous runs reduced cost but occasionally introduced subtle quality regressions that escape simple token-level metrics. This work aims to give ops and product confidence to apply automated recommendations with minimal human overhead through a hybrid acceptance model.

Key ideas introduced in this ticket: temporal acceptance windows (evaluate model deltas across short and medium term traffic slices), contextual similarity bucketing (group requests by prompt fingerprint before evaluating drift), dual-oracle scoring (automated semantic similarity + human spot-check), and graduated rollback tiers (soft revert, route-level fallback, emergency cold-swap). The probe suite is intentionally modular so it can be reused for different model families and for Dedicated/Private customers.

Deliverables:
- A runnable probe harness that accepts a candidate batch/cache config and executes: local simulation -> shadow traffic run -> micro-canary (0.5% traffic) -> progressive ramp with checkpoints.
- Golden prompt corpus generation module that synthesizes perturbations for robustness testing (synonym swaps, slot shuffles, context truncations).
- Acceptance engine implementing combined thresholds: semantic-stability score, latency/cost delta guardrails, and human-review sampling quotas.
- Rollback playbook with automated triggers and manual escalation steps, plus console hooks for visibility.

Non-goals: This ticket does not implement the recommendation engine itself (profiling -> suggested configs); it only provides the safety/acceptance layer and probe harness that will be called by the tuner service.
acceptance_criteria: Probe harness can run end-to-end against a candidate config in CI using a 10k-sample synthetic traffic trace
Semantic-stability metric computed per-prompt-bucket and exposed as time-series (mean and 95th percentile) in the console
Golden-prompt perturbation generator produces at least 5 unique variants per golden prompt (paraphrase, truncate, swap-entity, temperature-noise, slot-miss) and stores canonical fingerprint
Automated pass/fail decision if semantic-stability delta <= 0.015 (embedding cosine) OR p-value < 0.05 in one-sided bootstrap test for degradation; otherwise escalate to human review
Human review workflow samples at most 100 examples per canary and records binary pass/fail with reviewer notes
Rollback playbook executes a soft rollback (config disable) automatically if regression score exceeds high-severity threshold or if human review rejects
All probe runs produce an artifact bundle (metrics, sampled outputs, aggregated diffs, and reviewer annotations) and a link to the GitHub PR for the config change

Phase 2 (3w): integrate golden prompt generator and contextual bucketing; owner: Laura Gomez; add unit tests for perturbation types
Phase 3 (2w): wire acceptance engine, human-review UI hooks in Console, and automated rollback integration with router service; owner: SRE team lead (Carlos Ortiz)

Testing: add smoke test that runs canary on local dev cluster with synthetic latency injection to validate rollback path
